title: fix(desktop): guard reviewDiff all-add synthesis against tracked files
claim: Desktop reviewDiff (unstaged path) synthesizes a full-file 'new file mode' all-add for any file whose unstaged diff is empty, so a pristine or fully-staged tracked file (e.g. staged after the renderer's reviewList snapshot) renders as a brand-new file.

evidence.source: main apps/desktop/electron/git-review-ops.ts:370-385: empty `git diff -- file` falls straight to `git diff --no-index /dev/null file` with no `??` check (fileDiffVsHead at :408-414 has it). Same bug in the Python mirror hermes_cli/web_git.py:291-302 review_diff (`worktree if worktree.strip() else _all_add_diff(...)`), which the fork PR does not touch. Only renderer caller: src/store/review.ts:215 passes file.staged from the list snapshot, so reachability is the stale-snapshot race (external git add / commit / checkout).
evidence.red: On main, new test 'reviewDiff (unstaged) never renders a tracked file as a new-file all-add' fails at git-review-ops.test.ts:110: AssertionError expected '' but received 'diff --git 1/tracked.txt 2/tracked.txt\nnew file mode 100644 ... +tracked'.
evidence.green: With the 7-line `git status --porcelain` `??` guard (mirroring fileDiffVsHead): git-review-ops.test.ts 12/12 pass.
evidence.negative_control: Guard disabled (`if (false && ...)`) -> tracked-file test fails again with 'new file mode 100644'.
evidence.adjacent: electron git-binary-candidates, git-repo-scan, git-review-ops, git-root, git-worktree-ops, no-console-git test files: 6 files / 68 tests pass. Desktop typecheck NOT_TESTED (not packaged).
evidence.owner_check: Our two tests (tracked pristine + stale-staged -> ''; untracked still all-add) run against upstream #81164's git-review-ops.ts (head caa94c2) in an unmocked harness: 2/2 pass - #81164 already fixes this defect via `ls-files --others` resolution in BOTH backends.

upstream_overlap: #81164 OPEN (thelonewander3r, external, head caa94c2ee9, 2026-09-09; Fixes #81160/#81161): rewrites exactly this --no-index fallback in reviewDiff AND web_git.py review_diff to resolve untracked rows via `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard`; a tracked file resolves to nothing -> ''. Verified empirically. It does not claim this defect and has no reviewDiff tracked-file test (only fileDiffVsHead clean-tracked).

#95554 OPEN (sprmn24, external): blocks outside-repo paths in reviewDiff's --no-index fallback. Our `??` guard would incidentally also close that vector (git status on an outside path exits 128 -> ''), i.e. a separate PR would overlap two open external PRs on the same lines.
#110525 OPEN (teknium1) touches git-review-ops.ts but not this fallback.
notes: Support, don't compete: offer #81164 a review note + the reviewDiff tracked-file regression test (pristine and stale-staged -> '', untracked still all-add), which #81164 lacks and which passes on its head. Fork version is Electron-only and misses the identical Python sibling (hermes_cli/web_git.py review_diff); fork's `new Promise<string>` typing hunks are moot on main (execGit drift). If #81164 stalls/closes, a rebuild must cover both backends. Support diff saved at $S/a3/fork-48.support.diff (scratch).
